description: NHFLOW semi-implicit non-hydrostatic (A 510 11, A 520 2) with k-omega and implicit horizontal diffusion (A 512 2, nhflow_momentum_SI_hdiff.cpp): 3D flume, h = 0.109 m, 16 l/s, dx = 2 cm, two abutments as DIVEMesh solids (dry columns, A 541 1). The horizontal eddy diffusion no longer limits the time step: dt 0.0116 s at t = 8 s against 0.0068 s with the explicit horizontal diffusion; the water level gauges agree with it to 1.5 mm.
covers: implicit horizontal diffusion of the predictor (A 512 2, si_eta2D per layer and component)
time step without the horizontal diffusion limit (nhflow_timestep_SI)
DIVEMesh solids as dry columns with the non-hydrostatic pressure (A 541)
